CustomField.description: Determines date for last day of month for this year. Takes into account leap years.
CustomField.formula: DATE( VALUE( Period_Year__c), VALUE(Month_No__c), CASE(VALUE(Month_No__c), 2, IF( OR( MOD( VALUE( Period_Year__c), 400 ) = 0, AND( MOD( VALUE( Period_Year__c), 4 ) = 0, MOD( VALUE( Period_Year__c), 100 ) != 0 ) ), 29, 28), 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date for this year travel data
CustomField.label: TY Date
